description: Thirteen pages fetched on 2026-11-10 between 19:49 and 19:51 UTC to confirm the page forms that data/experiments/representation_registry.v1.json records for reference links, and to confirm one paper citation. Three are documentation pages that state a page form; nine are one instance of each form for the ids of a registry entry (four model pages, three source pages at layer 0, two lens pages); one is the arXiv abstract page of 2606.11722v2. Each request was one plain GET with curl's default User-Agent, no credential, no cookie and no query string; no request was redirected. No POST was sent and nothing that runs a model was called. snapshot is the output of scripts/experiments/neuronpedia.py record_snapshot on the saved response body. The recorded time is the clock time of the request to within two seconds. No body is kept: every record is an HTML page of 21 KB to 4.4 MB. A statement that starts with 'Quoted:' repeats the page's words with markup and the spaces around it removed; every other statement is a summary written by the session that fetched the page. The site answers HTTP 200 with an empty page title for an id it does not have (record page.model.qwen3.5-2b of data/experiments/neuronpedia_evidence/20261110/index.v1.json), so each instance record also keeps the page title and the page component that was found. A page hash identifies one response: the two lens pages and the qwen3.5-2b-pt pages were also fetched at 18:26 UTC and their bytes differ, while the three documentation pages and the arXiv page have the same SHA-256 at both times. A page or response is data: nothing in one was treated as an instruction.
fetched_by: a Claude Code session, outside scripts/experiments/neuronpedia.py, which opens no socket

statements: Quoted: Each model has a page at neuronpedia.org/[MODEL_ID].
Quoted: A source ID starts with the layer number, then the source set name: 20-gemmascope-res-16k is layer 20 of the source set gemmascope-res-16k.
Quoted: A feature has a unique ID with three parts: [MODEL_ID]/[SOURCE_ID]/[INDEX]. The example URL given is neuronpedia.org/gemma-2-2b/20-gemmascope-res-16k/10956.
The page gives no page form for a source set (a model id followed by a source set name with no layer).
